run_retrieval_pipeline: run the DPR retrieval pipeline to search passage embeddings and output top-k results as JSON
build_faiss_index: build a FAISS inner product index from a list of pickled context embedding files
merge_retrieval_results: merge retrieved document IDs and scores with passage text and questions into structured results
create_argparse_parser: create an argparse parser with arguments for context embeddings, queries, questions, passages, and topk
run_main_retrieval: run the main retrieval function that indexes passages, searches queries, and writes merged JSON output
